content: Yes, that is correct. In Switzerland, the adult basic health insurance (LAMal) typically includes a deductible (franchise) of CHF 300 per year, but some plans offer a lower deductible of CHF 150. After the deductible is met, there is no limit on the co-payments (co-payments or co-insurance) for covered treatments and services. However, note that this information is based on general knowledge and may change over time or depend on specific insurance plans and regulatory updates. It's always advisable to consult with a health insurance provider or a qualified professional for the most current and accurate information.
